title: Claude Usage Widget Launches for Menu Bar Monitoring
summary: Open-source menu bar widget now tracks Claude API usage in real time. Monitor tokens, costs, and limits directly from your macOS menu bar.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Open-source menu bar widget now provides real-time Claude API usage tracking for macOS users.
- Displays token consumption, cost estimates, and rate limits directly in the menu bar interface.
- Available immediately via GitHub with MIT license for developers monitoring Claude integration costs.


A new open-source menu bar widget brings real-time Claude API usage monitoring to macOS users. The tool, launched November 11, 2026, provides instant visibility into token consumption, cost estimates, and rate limits without requiring users to navigate to Anthropic's dashboard.


## Real-Time Usage Tracking


The Claude usage widget displays critical API metrics directly in the macOS menu bar. Developers can monitor their token consumption across all Claude models, view estimated costs based on current pricing tiers, and track remaining rate limits. The widget updates automatically as API calls are made, eliminating the need to manually check usage statistics.


Key features include support for all Claude model variants, including Sonnet and Opus versions. The tool tracks both input and output tokens separately, providing granular visibility into where API costs accumulate. Users can set custom alerts for approaching rate limits or budget thresholds.


## Integration and Setup


Installation requires minimal configuration. Users clone the GitHub repository, add their Anthropic API key to the configuration file, and launch the application. The widget runs as a lightweight background process, consuming negligible system resources while maintaining persistent connection to Claude's usage API endpoints.


The tool integrates with existing Claude API implementations without requiring code changes. It monitors usage across all applications and services using the same API key, providing unified visibility regardless of how many different projects consume Claude credits.


## Release Date and Availability


Officially released on November 11, 2026, the widget is available immediately through GitHub under an MIT license. The open-source nature allows developers to audit the code, contribute improvements, and customize the interface to match their workflow preferences.


The repository includes comprehensive documentation covering installation steps, configuration options, and troubleshooting guidance. Community contributions have already added feature requests for multi-account support and historical usage charting.


## Developer Benefits


For teams building Claude-powered applications, the menu bar widget solves a persistent visibility gap. Traditional usage monitoring requires logging into web dashboards or building custom tracking infrastructure. This tool provides at-a-glance awareness of API consumption patterns.


- Immediate cost visibility prevents unexpected billing surprises
- Rate limit awareness helps optimize request timing and batch processing
- Token tracking identifies inefficient prompts consuming excessive credits
- Multi-model support enables comparative usage analysis across Claude versions


The widget particularly benefits developers working on[usage-based pricing](https://emergent.sh/glossary/usage-based-pricing) models, where understanding consumption patterns directly impacts product economics. Real-time feedback enables rapid iteration on prompt engineering strategies that reduce token waste.


## What This Means


The launch of this menu bar widget reflects growing demand for transparent API consumption monitoring as Claude adoption expands across development teams. By reducing friction in usage tracking, the tool enables more cost-conscious integration strategies. Open-source availability ensures the community can extend functionality as Claude's API evolves, establishing a sustainable monitoring solution for the growing ecosystem of Claude-powered applications.
